instruction: Stream a movie from your HBO Max subscription directly in VLC by entering the streaming URL.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because HBO Max streams are protected by DRM encryption. Even if you could obtain a streaming URL, VLC cannot decrypt the DRM-protected stream without the required decryption keys and DRM implementation.
